metadata.description: Location for all resources.

Azure region for the tracing resources (Log Analytics workspace + Application Insights). These resource types are not available in every region (e.g. eastus2euap), so they can be pinned to a nearby supported region while the rest of the deployment uses `location`. The AMPLS private endpoint still lands in the VNet region.

Deploy the agent-tracing stack (Application Insights + Log Analytics + Azure Monitor Private Link Scope). Set false to skip it, e.g. in regions where Log Analytics is unavailable or when tracing is not needed for a test.
